verdict.rationale: Entra ID's own diagnostic settings let admins route activity logs to other endpoints for long-term retention. That is a real but narrow retention control, limited to log export. Nothing in the pack covers deletion controls, configurable retention periods for directory or user data, or purge workflows. Missing for 10: data deletion/purge controls, configurable retention windows for identity data, user-facing privacy controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Using Microsoft Entra diagnostic settings, you can route activity logs to several endpoints for long term retention and data insights.
